subject: Sunridge renewal MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and initial timeline
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Ava Ross <ava.ross@sunridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sunridge renewal MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and initial timeline

Hi Ava — thanks again for the chat yesterday. As we start the renewal conversation, we'd like to formalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have a shared set of goals, owners, and a target close window. I copied the internal folks who will support the evaluation and operational handoff.

Quick context: Sunridge is up for renewal on 2026-07-20 and we discussed an expansion opportunity to bring additional inference capacity for your QA and personalization pipelines. The goals here are:
- Confirm renewal terms and updated committed capacity
- Run a short eval of the new quantized model in a dev/staging lane (2–3 weeks)
- Validate cost/latency improvements on production-like slices
- Agree on rollout/rollback triggers and canary thresholds

Proposed initial timeline:
- Week of 6/8: MAP draft distributed and internal stakeholder assignments
- Week of 6/15: Evaluation kickoff (access + test prompts)
- Week of 7/6: Results review and pricing/contract alignment
- Target close: 7/20

Immediate asks:
1) Could you confirm who owns engineering acceptance and who will be the procurement contact on your side?
2) Any additional evaluation metrics we should include beyond latency and token cost (e.g., specific accuracy/regression checks)?

Attachments: draft MAP template (spreadsheet) — I’ll share a first pass in a follow-up.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Ava Ross <ava.ross@sunridge.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@sunridge.ai>, procurement@sunridge.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunridge renewal MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and initial timeline

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and timely. Quick answers:
- Engineering acceptance: Samir Patel (Director of Applied ML) — he owns model validation and will coordinate with our SREs.
- Procurement contact: procurement@sunridge.ai (cc’d). They’ll need the draft SOW and updated pricing by early July.
- Evaluation metrics: please add A/B pass-rate on our personalization cohort, 99th percentile latency for 512-token requests, and per-request cost estimates.

I’m also adding our CTO, Maya Chen, and Head of Product, Elena Voss, to the thread internally so they see the plan. For now I’m OK with the proposed timeline but can push the evaluation start to 6/17 if engineering needs a few extra days.

Attached a usage snapshot for May so you can tune the test slices.

Attachments: sunridge_usage_May2026.pdf (summary, top 10 routes)

Best,
Ava

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunridge renewal MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and initial timeline

Looping in a proposed MAP draft and an expansion play suggestion. Ava — thanks for the usage file, that’s helpful. I reviewed the top routes and recommend we prioritize: personalization-infer, session-summary, and search-rewrite for the initial canary.

What I’m attaching: a first-pass MAP spreadsheet with owners, acceptance criteria, and a short test-plan column. Key asks from our side:
- Access: a dev API key and a reproducible prompt set for each route (preferably with 200 example requests each).
- Data slice: include a cohort flagged as "sensitive" so we can run privacy-preserving checks (no customer PII).
- Success criteria: 5–10% cost improvement target for quantized model + no >2% regression on QA pass rate.

On expansion: to make procurement comfortable, we propose a 3-month reserved capacity add-on with a 30-day opt-out window tied to canary metrics; Marissa will own the rollout checklist and Evelyn will monitor production telemetry during the canary.

I’ll upload the MAP draft to the shared drive and send a link shortly. If Sunridge can confirm resource availability for testing by 6/17, we’ll keep the original pace; otherwise we shift start to 6/22.

Attachments: sunridge_MAP_draft.xlsx

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Ava Ross <ava.ross@sunridge.ai>, procurement@sunridge.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sunridge renewal MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and initial timeline

Thanks everyone — productive thread. Quick summary and agreed next steps:
1) Sunridge owners: Samir Patel (engineering acceptance), procurement@sunridge.ai (contracts). Ava will request CTO/Product visibility as needed.
2) Draft MAP: Marissa shared sunridge_MAP_draft.xlsx — internal owners assigned and success criteria proposed.
3) Evaluation start: tentative 6/17 pending confirmation from Samir; fallback start 6/22. Please confirm by EOD 6/11.
4) Deliverables for evaluation kickoff:
   - Dev API key + 200-example prompt sets per route (Sunridge)
   - Baseline request slices + May usage (Sunridge provided)
   - Canary plan and rollback triggers (Redwood/Marissa)

Procurement: I’ll follow up with a redline-friendly SOW and provisional pricing by 7/2 so you have time for review ahead of the 7/20 target.

If that aligns, I’ll convert the draft MAP to a shared editable doc and set a 30-minute checkpoint for 6/17 to confirm test readiness.

Best — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
